learning_outcomes.description: Reflect on and evaluate your employability skillset and attributes.
Communicate your employability skillset and attributes.
Create a professional development plan to further build upon your employability skills.
Critically reflect on and articulate key business practices, processes and challenges within an organisation.

assessments.task_description: To complete this assessment and pass the course, you must secure a host organisation that can provide meaningful work to support skill development, arrange and complete the placement through an agreed schedule (e.g., block, part-time weekly) that will total 80-100 hours, negotiate working hours with the organisation and have the internship supervisor (or appropriate designate) complete the industry supervisor evaluation form.
assessments.submission_guidelines: The industry supervisor evaluation form will be submitted online by your supervisor who would have received a link to the form at the time your internship was approved. Once they’ve completed and submitted the form, you will automatically receive an emailed copy.
assessments.deferral_or_extension: You cannot defer or apply for an extension for this assessment.
assessments.late_submission: A penalty of 10% of the maximum possible mark will be deducted per 24 hours from time submission is due for up to 7 days. After 7 days, you will receive a mark of 0.
assessments.additional_info: You cannot defer or apply for an extension for this assessment.

assessments.task_description:
In this assessment, you will showcase your reflective skills by analysing and reflecting on the business/organisation you observed and engaged with during your placement. You will critically reflect on the practices, processes, challenges and/or successes of the business or organisation you worked in. Your observations will lead you to develop a foundational understanding of how businesses operate, their managerial decision-making, and how businesses respond to wider industry/economic forces.

The assessment will consist of two parts:

  • A2.1: Written Reflection

You are required to prepare a written reflection that presents your observations and critical analysis of a significant or consequential practice, process, challenge and/or opportunity within the business or organisation in which you completed your placement. Your reflection should explore the key learnings gained from this experience and explicitly connect these insights to the development of your employability skills and personal attributes. The written reflection will be submitted in two parts: Part 1 (Formative) Initial Reflection: Due Friday, 18 December 2026, at 5:00 pm and Part 2 – Final Reflection: Due Friday, 8 January 2027, at 5:00 pm.

Part 2 should build upon your initial reflection (and feedback received), demonstrating deeper critical analysis and consideration of how your workplace experiences have contributed to your professional development.

  • A2.2: Interactive Oral Assessment

You will participate in a semi-structured, individual online consultation with your lecturer to discuss the significant workplace issue, practice, process, challenge or opportunity identified in A2.1. During the consultation, you will be expected to critically reflect on your experience, articulate your key learnings, and explain how these have contributed to the development of your employability skills and personal attributes. The consultation provides an opportunity to demonstrate your ability to communicate and transfer your professional learning to future workplace contexts.

Assessment period: 11–29 January 2027. You will be required to book an individual consultation time with your lecturer. Booking instructions will be provided through Blackboard.

Secure Assessment Materials Allowed or Prohibited

You may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Translation (MT) tools to support your learning and assessment preparation for the written reflection and preparation for your Interactive Oral Assessment. You must transparently acknowledge any use of AI or MT. The use of AI during the Interactive Oral Assessment is not permitted.

assessments.task_description:
In this assessment, you will develop a comprehensive and critically reflective Professional Development Plan that evaluates your employability and identifies priorities for your future professional growth. Your plan should draw on:

  • Self-evaluation of your placement performance and professional learning.
  • Feedback from supervisors, mentors and colleagues.
  • Relevant self-assessment tools and instruments.
  • Research into industry expectations, employment trends and emerging skill requirements.
  • UQ’s graduate attributes and employability capabilities.

You will identify key areas for development and establish a clear, achievable action plan with specific goals and strategies for improvement. Your plan should conclude with a critical consideration of your professional identity, career aspirations and future career pathways, demonstrating how you intend to transfer your learning from the placement into your ongoing personal and professional development.
